findings.title: ITC cliff — BOC deadline already passed and no evidence provided
findings.text: Under OBBBA, the 30% solar ITC (~$30M+ on 100 MW) is forfeited unless physical-work BOC was documented by July 4, 2026 — a deadline already passed as of the research date. No BOC evidence package is in the dossier. This is the single largest go/no-go item; make BOC evidence a condition precedent.

findings.title: SOAR voter-approval overlay is a potential kill-switch on ag/open-space land
findings.text: Ventura County's SOAR measures (A/B) require countywide voter approval to change land-use designations on protected agricultural and open-space land. A 100 MW solar farm on SOAR-protected farmland cannot be approved by the Board of Supervisors alone — it would need a ballot measure. This is the Ventura analog of the Solano 'zoning kill switch' and must be verified against the actual parcel. No SOAR status was provided.

findings.title: Empty facts array — no site acreage, parcels, or zoning data supplied
findings.text: site_acres is null and no parcel APNs, zoning district, or SOAR status is given. A 100 MW solar+storage project typically needs ~600–700 acres (~6 ac/MWac). Without parcel/zoning/SOAR data, zoning feasibility and the entire entitlement path are unassessable.

findings.title: CEC Opt-In eligibility hinges on ≥200 MWh storage — storage size unstated
findings.text: 100 MW solar meets the ≥50 MW solar threshold, but Opt-In also requires storage ≥200 MWh. The project is labeled 'solar+storage' with no storage MWh given. If storage <200 MWh, the project is ineligible for the 270-day state certification that preempts local zoning — forcing the slower, litigation-prone local CEQA path.

findings.title: No permitting path or status provided
findings.text: The dossier contains no EIR status, no CEC Opt-In application, no permit stack. A 100 MW farmland project cannot proceed without a full EIR (12–24 mo) or a CEC Opt-In certificate (270 days). The permitting path is undetermined, which alone blocks any COD commitment.
